features.apiAndChecks: API and verification on every change

q1.q: Does EXEGEZIS change anything on my website?
q1.a: No. It only browses and reads, like a visitor. It doesn’t submit forms or press buttons that change data. What your own website does by itself when it loads is recorded and shown to you.

q2.a: A problem is only marked as verified if it appears in every repetition and its evidence is recorded. What appears only sometimes is shown apart as intermittent.

q3.q: Can I check websites that aren’t mine?
q3.a: Only with permission. You are asked to confirm the first time, and robots.txt is respected unless you say the site is yours.

q4.q: What does the AI do, and what doesn’t it do?
q4.a: It proposes test plans, quotes and related terms. It never decides a verdict: the engine checks everything, and an invented quote is discarded.

q5.a: We never see them. You sign in yourself, and only the session is saved, encrypted. You can delete it whenever you want.

q6.q: Does it work with mobile apps or plugins?
q6.a: Today, with websites. APIs, mobile apps, plugins and desktop are on the way, with the same rule.
